subfiles.title: List of papers concerning petroleum in the Kwantung Leased Territory
subfiles.from: U.S. Department of State file staff
subfiles.about: A two-page index lists correspondence and consular reports concerning the petroleum monopoly, refinery operations, supplies, and trade in Dairen and Manchuria.
subfiles.summary: Lists 1935-38 Dairen reports on the oil monopoly, foreign reactions, the Kanseishi refinery, crude shipments, the Texas Company's stance, imports, Soviet interest in Dairen supplies, and Manchuria oil output, many cross-indexed under 893.6363.

interest: Shows Dairen's petroleum monopoly and refinery emerging alongside foreign-company reactions and Soviet commercial interest.
